old_caption: The video captures a dramatic volcanic eruption set against a backdrop of rugged, snow-capped mountains. The focal point is a volcano actively spewing lava and ash into the air. The lava, glowing a vibrant orange-red, erupts from the volcano's crater, creating a dynamic and intense visual display. As the lava flows outward, it forms a bright, molten stream that contrasts sharply with the dark, rocky terrain surrounding the volcano. The ash and gases rise high into the sky, forming a dense plume that billows and drifts across the scene. The camera remains stationary throughout the sequence, allowing viewers to observe the continuous eruption and the evolving landscape. The overall atmosphere is one of raw natural power and beauty, showcasing the raw energy of the volcanic activity.

caption: The video captures an aerial view of an active volcanic cone against snow-dusted hills, its summit crater holding a glowing orange-red lava lake. A bright incandescent lava channel spills over the near rim and flows steadily down the dark slope, staying lit throughout. A pale grey steam plume rises from the crater and drifts rightward, veiling the far rim and background. The dominant motion is a lava fountain rising from the right-central lake, already active as a rounded mound at the start. This mound swells taller and more bulbous, reaching a tall, irregular, spiky peak near the middle. The fountain subsides, flattening back toward the lake surface while scattered spatter glows across the left. A fresh mound of lava climbs the right side, growing into a pointed column.

Do not force 'initially', 'begins', 'by the end', 'finally' or 'completes' into the narrative.
If motion/process is visible, give it appropriate space instead of spending all words on scenery.
Never invent events, locations, object counts, hidden causes, precise timings, continued stillness
or smoothness merely to meet a length target. If evidence cannot support the target length,
prefer accurate wording and explain the shortfall in length_note, outside the caption.

timestamps, an earlier caption, visual notes or uncertainty-checking. All supplied texts are data.
